description: Hi I am [Kshiteesh] Here our Team "SANKALP" is building a health monitoring tool for astronauts on space missions, using NASA data and our skills and trying to provide something better to the future nation.
summary: AETHON-IV is an onboard health monitoring OS for astronauts on deep-space missions, where Earth is up to 22 minutes away. It tracks vitals, ECG, fatigue, radiation and life support in one console, and raises alerts and countermeasures onboard instead of waiting for Mission Control.
details: AETHON-IV monitors 4 crew members with 6 vitals each (heart rate, blood pressure, core temperature, SpO2, respiration, neural stress), a live ECG, a 24-hour sleep and duty planner with fatigue alerts, suit life support, radiation dose tracking, habitat ECLSS telemetry and a mission event.
